rows: - 24 Nov, iOS reference comparison (n=1 per screen, no model). `wf test ios-visual --reference` normalized and compared the dark approval picker in 5.11 s and reproduced the golden's 174 differing pixels. The same harness compared the reordered LeetCode keyboard in 8.23 s, wrote the mismatch images, and exited 1 with 248,955 differing pixels (6.979% at the shared pixelmatch tolerance). Keep the reference mode so device evidence and design diffs use one command.
